question: Ops review of research/VMHUB_DESIGN.md (VMHUB rev3 + DEV-VMBUDGET gateway), incl. where the user's kill switch lives
agree: one gateway as the only model path, enforced by a grep test; caps read from policy.json on every call; fail-closed + shadow/1 rejected_by budget
commit gate and push gate deterministic with 0 model calls; push credential only in the Ops core; shadow refs until cutover; revert, never force
append-only journal, replay to the same state, idempotent outbox by id
order: gateway+budgets and R3-DET first, session manager/gates held
disagree: §2 policy integrity is circular: the 'user-approved policy hash given at the boundary' arrives from cloud sessions, which are agents; any session could send a new hash. Today every policy.json commit is authored by a Claude session recording user words, so 'user-signed commit' does not exist yet. Proposal: the enforcing copy of the policy lives on the VM in a file owned by a different Unix user (root, mode 0644), written only by the user over SSH; the VM's ga user can read but not write it. baseline policy.json becomes the declared mirror; Ops compares the VM-reported policy hash with the hash of the mirror every hour and files incident/1 on mismatch.

§3 kill switch as 'a policy key the VM cannot write' still depends on the VM process reading it; a hung or buggy VM ignores it. Proposal: three layers, all outside what the VM measures or controls: (1) soft halt = `halt: true` in the root-owned VM policy file, read every tick, missing/unreadable = halt; (2) hard spend stop = a spend limit set by the user at the model provider console on the VM's own API key + key revoke there; (3) hard stop = user stops the instance in the Oracle console / revokes the VM's GitHub push credential. Ops tests (1) and the push-credential revoke once in shadow and records time-to-stop; (2)/(3) are user actions named in a status/1 blocker.

§1.1 budget check uses a pre-call estimate only; R0 shows cache_read ~74% of cost and estimates drift. Add post-call reconciliation (actual USD into the window; the next call sees it) and a provider-side cap as the backstop, so an estimate error cannot exceed the user's caps by more than one call.
missing: hourly VM boundary report for Ops (status/1 or registry form): per cap window spend vs limit, calls, 0-call share, estimate-vs-actual error, refusals by cap, sessions created/ended/refused, commit gate pass/fail with rule ids, pushes {sha, ref, actor}, running ga-sdk SHA, policy hash. Ops stores it as ops/flow/measure/vm_spend.json and rows in hourly.jsonl; without it OPS-VMBUDGET can only read VM caps as null.

cap applicability (purpose -> caps) belongs in policy.json as user-owned data, not as sets in gateway code; vm_budget also holds cloud_top_baseline_usd_per_h and session_ctx_cap_tokens, which the VM gateway must not apply.
window definitions: per-hour = rolling 60 min or clock hour; per-day = KST calendar day or rolling 24 h (user question; Ops proposes rolling for both, KST day for reporting).
test that a worker push with --no-verify still fails (credential absence, not only the PRE_PUSH hook).
restart re-admission must count the interrupted session's spend once (no double charge, no free retry).
facts: policy.json vm_budget caps: coord 1.0 USD/h, baselines 2.0 USD/h, total 6.0 USD/h, 30 USD/day, item 3 soft / 6 hard
VM today: 0 model calls (ASK-VM-COST until 01:0x), ga 0.18.1, SHA unreported since 10-06 20:26 KST (DEV-VMSHA acting)
ops/hub/measure_hourly.py already records every cap with value/limit/breach; VM values null until a VM report exists
risk: policy forged by an agent -> caps raised without the user (high; fixed by the root-owned VM policy)
kill switch inside VM control -> no stop on a hung VM (high; fixed by provider/console layers)
estimate drift -> cap overrun (medium; reconciliation + provider cap)
first_step: With the R1 gateway (DEV-VMAUTO/DEV-VMBUDGET), ship the hourly VM boundary report and the soft halt flag in the root-owned VM policy file; Ops wires the report into measure_hourly and runs the halt test once in shadow before any gate work is unheld.
